exposure: Advanced maternal age (AMA, defined as age ≥35 years at delivery)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 307 nulliparous women undergoing induction of labor (IOL) from 38 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks of gestation
finding: Advanced maternal age (AMA) was independently associated with a three-fold increased likelihood of cesarean delivery and operative vaginal delivery in uncomplicated nulliparous women following induction of labor.
mod_finding: AMA was associated with an approximately three-fold increased likelihood of birth by CD and operative vaginal delivery in uncomplicated nulliparous women following IOL.
